resources.string: Keep your backup channel and Saved Messages recovery notes. Deleting the channel in Telegram can permanently remove your backups. Archiving and muting reduces clutter; it does not lock or protect the channel against deletion.

Move this backup channel to Telegram’s archive and mute its notifications? It remains accessible and deletable in Telegram. No originals, channel or recovery notes will be deleted. Telegram may move an archived chat back to the main list according to its settings.
